input: Buy a standing mixer for holiday baking

gold.taskTitle: Buy a Standing Mixer for Holiday Baking
gold.taskDescription: Research and purchase a standing mixer suited to the user's holiday baking needs.

questions.title: What is your total budget for this mixer?
questions.description: Understanding the price range will narrow down suitable models and brands.

questions.title: Which specific holiday recipes will you be making?
questions.description: Knowing the recipes helps determine the power, capacity, and attachments needed.

questions.title: How often do you plan to use it beyond the holidays?
questions.description: Frequency of use affects whether a heavy-duty or lighter model makes more sense.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred brand already in mind?
questions.description: A brand preference can immediately filter the research and comparison process.

questions.title: What bowl capacity do you need in quarts?
questions.description: Batch size for holiday baking determines the minimum bowl size required.

questions.title: Where do you plan to buy it, online or in store?
questions.description: The purchase channel affects price comparison, availability, and delivery timing.

questions.title: When exactly do you need it ready to use?
questions.description: The deadline determines how urgently the purchase decision needs to be made.
